source: onboarding: Mansfield Township School District (Burlington County)

schools.name: John Hydock Elementary School
schools.absence_instructions: Before 9:00 AM, call (609) 298-0308 and choose option 2 to leave a message about the absence. For an illness, give your child's symptoms and, if there is a fever, the temperature.

sacc.am_hours: 6:45 AM - start of school (at Mansfield Township Elementary; John Hydock students are bused)
sacc.late_pickup_policy: All children must be picked up by 6:00 PM. $5 for every 5 minutes late, plus $10 on the second late pickup and $20 on the third; a child may be removed from the program after 3 late pickups.
sacc.pickup_change_procedure: Only adults listed on the enrollment forms may pick up; send a note to authorize anyone else. For an emergency authorization, call or text the program's cell. If your child is in school but skipping the program, tell the school secretary and the program.
sacc.closures_notes: Mansfield Village Program (MVP), run by the district at Mansfield Township Elementary for grades K-6; John Hydock students are bused to and from it. No program when schools close for snow or ice or close early for weather; no before-care on delayed openings; on early-dismissal days care starts at dismissal.
